DICELEDGER.Title: Dice Ledger
DICELEDGER.OpenHint: Every die rolled in this campaign, by player and by face. Also on the dice button among the token tools.
DICELEDGER.WhoCanViewHint: Players see rolls made in the open and their own whispered and self rolls. Blind rolls count for the GM only.
DICELEDGER.Remind: Remind Me to Start a Session
DICELEDGER.RemindHint: When you join as GM and no session is running, say so. Nothing is counted until a session is started.
DICELEDGER.Reminder: Dice Ledger isn't counting: no session is running. Start one from the dice button among the token tools.
DICELEDGER.NotRecorder: Another GM is the one counting rolls in this game, so only they can start, end or delete sessions.
DICELEDGER.NotAllowed: Only the GM can open the Dice Ledger in this world.
DICELEDGER.Started: Dice Ledger: {name} started. Rolls count from now on.
DICELEDGER.Ended: Dice Ledger: {name} ended. Rolls no longer count.
DICELEDGER.DeleteConfirm: Delete {name} and every roll counted in it? This can't be undone.
DICELEDGER.NotRecording: Not counting. Rolls only count while a session is running.
DICELEDGER.IncludeDroppedHint: Dice the roll set aside again, like the lower d20 of advantage or a rerolled 1. They were rolled, so they count by default.
DICELEDGER.NoSessions: Nothing counted yet. Start a session and every die rolled from then on lands here.
DICELEDGER.FairLine: Where every face would sit on a perfectly fair die
